content.short: ChainSecurity provides smart-contract auditing services and develops tools to protect Web3 protocols.
content.description: ChainSecurity delivers smart-contract and blockchain protocol security solutions, combining products and professional services with ongoing research and development in security, program analysis, and machine learning. ChainSecurity is known for Securify, the smart-contract analyzer, and VerX, the smart-contract verifier. Crypto projects rely on ChainSecurity's in-depth audits to ensure robust security across their contracts and protocols.
content.meta: ChainSecurity audits smart contracts and secures blockchain protocols. Discover ChainSecurity and other Web3 Security Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
